THE PROBLEM

Satellites see Earth change. Most people cannot check.

  • "Pollution is falling." "The Arctic is warming."
  • The data sits in tables only specialists read.
  • Is a change real, or just random variation?
Terra Trace · NASA Space Apps 20262 / 7

THE SOLUTION

Verdict first, evidence on demand

  • Pick a place and a NASA measurement
  • See the direction, the size and how sure we are
  • Open the statistics only if you want them
  • Guided demo and Help me choose for new users
Terra Trace · NASA Space Apps 20263 / 7

HOW WE KNOW

Is the trend real?

  • Remove the seasonal cycle
  • Theil-Sen slope, Mann-Kendall test
  • Adjust for neighbouring months being alike
  • Check El Niño, find turning points
  • Scan 33 combinations with false-discovery control
Terra Trace · NASA Space Apps 20264 / 7

A REAL DISCOVERY

NO2 over the North China Plain rose, peaked about 2012, then fell

Turned around in 2012Not explained by El Niño

-2.1 ×10¹⁵ molecules/cm² per decade overall, very strong evidence (p < 0.001).

Terra Trace · NASA Space Apps 20265 / 7

NASA DATA MAKES IT POSSIBLE

Six NASA products, nine regions

  • MERRA-2: air temperature
  • GPM IMERG: precipitation
  • GLDAS: terrestrial water storage
  • Aura OMI: tropospheric NO2
  • MODIS-Aqua: sea surface temperature
  • AIRS: lower and upper air temperature
  • GIBS: map imagery. Data via Giovanni.
Terra Trace · NASA Space Apps 20266 / 7

IMPACT AND NEXT STEPS

Anyone can test a claim about our planet

  • For students, teachers and curious people: a guided demo, plain-language answers, sourced examples
  • Honest about limits: "consistent with", never "proves"
  • Next: more regions, live NASA data, more languages
